title: Built 4 trading strategies with Claude — 4 months of forward testing results
author: Odds_archive
selftext:
I’ve built four trading strategies using Claude, and while I’m not ready to claim I’ve found a real edge yet, I feel like I’m getting closer.  
I’ve just completed four months of forward testing, and my goal is to continue testing through January before putting real capital behind these strategies.  
Here are the results so far:  
**Strategy 1**  
Net profit: +$6,430  
Win rate: 54%  
Total trades: 168  
Green months: 2/4  
**Strategy 2**  
Net profit: +$3,390  
Win rate: 57%  
Total trades: 28  
Green months: 4/4  
**Strategy 3**  
Net profit: +$9,735  
Win rate: 54%  
Total trades: 544  
Green months: 3/4  
**Strategy 4**  
Net profit: +$9,255  
Win rate: 57%  
Total trades: 95  
Green months: 4/4  
All profits are net of fees.  
One thing I want to clarify: **I didn’t ask Claude to build me a profitable trading strategy.** I put these systems together myself, piece by piece. I started with small ideas and gradually developed them into more complex strategies. Claude has been a tool for helping me analyze and test data, explore ideas, and speed up the research process.  
The ability to test ideas against data and iterate quickly has been a huge part of this journey.  
I know four months isn’t enough to prove these strategies have a durable edge, which is why I want to keep forward testing before committing real capital.  
I’m curious what other people think. If you were in my position, what would you focus on during the next few months to gain more confidence that these results are real and not just luck?
